attribution.title: Landscape
attribution.authors: Jan-Walter Schliep, Burak Kahraman and Timm Dapper (Laubwerk)
attribution.changes: Converted PBRT triangle meshes, images, physical materials, light and camera to a Sashiko scene package. Converted centimetres to metres about a local origin and reflected world X, with corresponding mesh winding and tangent handedness. Flipped image V coordinates and generated tangents and texture mipmaps. The interactive preview maps materials to metallic-roughness shading and thresholds opacity.
